rules: No statewide total without a defensible independent denominator.
Recall counts a benchmark organization once; aliases, program cohorts and squads are not extra clubs.
A search snippet is a discovery lead, not a successfully retrieved publisher page or verified organization.
Blocked sources remain failures; public publisher-issued alternate documents may be separately registered subject to their own access rules.
Source snapshot publication date is separate from retrieval date; a 2025-26 list is historical evidence, not proof of 2026-27 membership.
No club ownership from schedule opponent names; no youth eligibility from a name alone.
Prescribed source results and held-out independent discovery are evaluated separately.
Blocked prescribed sources are blocked/not evaluated, never passed on fixture results.
Controlled fixtures prove change handling only, never live discovery recall.
Acquisition reads job configuration and permitted live pages only; benchmarks are read only by the separate evaluator after result sealing.
Benchmark assembly uses separate research and publisher lists; same-analyst and small-sample limitations must be disclosed.
New verified records are reviewed before optional publication; unknown fields and incomplete sources remain explicit.

metrics.precisionReason: Full output pool not independently adjudicated; unknowns cannot be counted as true positives.
